title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
mission: Exercise the canonical repository proposal-claim path with two or more deliberately colliding create-if-absent attempts for one deterministic fingerprint; persist winner/loser evidence, prove no overwrite, preserve lineage, and do not promote queue or product authority.

information_gain.reason: The current implementation explicitly leaves repository-host create-if-absent semantics untested; this closes that stated evidence gap.

regression_prevention.reason: A host-specific race can falsify whether concurrent discovery workers can overwrite or duplicate a semantic pin under real repository contention.

fail_if: more than one durable pin exists for the same fingerprint
the canary self-promotes READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
